name: Demo Heroku - Add Remove Elements
description: Add multiple dynamic buttons, verify the count, delete one, and verify the remaining count.

testSteps.name: Open add remove page
testSteps.description: Navigate to the public add/remove elements page.

testSteps.name: Add demo elements
testSteps.description: Click Add Element {addElementCount} times and store the expected count.

testSteps.name: Verify added element count
testSteps.description: Verify the number of delete buttons matches the stored expected count.

testSteps.name: Delete one element
testSteps.description: Delete one dynamic element and update expected count.

testSteps.name: Verify remaining element count
testSteps.description: Verify one fewer dynamic element remains.
